#include "ara/tsync/timestamp.h"
Description:
The class TimeBase is a pseudo-clock.
The class TimeBase is a pseudo-clock that is used as the first template argument to
std::chrono::time_point to indicate that the time point represents local time with respect of a
not-yet-specified timeBaseResource.
